onsite_service: Onsite service is for organizations only; our team checks feasibility and quotes any travel fee. We do not offer home visits.
discount_policy: There are no automatic discounts. Only a promotion approved by an authorized manager can change a quotation.
cancellation_policy: You can withdraw a request at any time. Once confirmed, you can reschedule or cancel free of charge 24 hours or more before your slot; closer than that, and for any refund, our team reviews the request. A request is not an approved refund.
refund_policy: Our team reviews refunds for paid appointments. Approval and processing time are not guaranteed.
results_policy: Preparation instructions and result timing come from our team for your specific appointment. We do not apply a universal fasting rule or promise a turnaround time.
payment_policy: Pay at the center, or with a test PromptPay or card payment that moves no real money. A screenshot is not proof of payment, and we never ask for card numbers in chat.
privacy_policy: Use synthetic data only in this coursework system. Employers receive coordination information, never an employee's lab results. A production service would need its own consent, retention and data-processing approvals.
handoff_policy: Our team works Monday to Saturday, 07:00–16:00 Bangkok time. Outside those hours your request waits in the queue without a promised response time. Urgent health concerns should not wait here: contact emergency or medical services.
source_note: Customer-facing wording revised 2026-10-06 without changing the rules of version 2026-10-05-proposed.
